answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks using hardware-rooted attestation verified on a juniper ledger. Each agent must execute inside a tamper-resistant enclave and answer challenges from the sparrow network. This forces attackers to buy discrete physical silicon and vendor root keys per identity, preventing zero-cost cloning on a single host island. However, relying on closed-source hardware vendors creates supply-chain centralization and side-channel exposure.
